---
title: "Practical Meta-analysis for Evidence Synthesis in the Agri-food Sector"
---

## About this resource

This open teaching package introduces quantitative evidence synthesis using **R** and **metafor**, with examples framed around agri-food research.

The course follows a question-first workflow:

**Question → estimand → compatible evidence → effect size → model → uncertainty → interpretation.**

It is designed for instructor-led workshops and self-directed learning.

## Learning outcomes

By the end, participants should be able to:

- choose and interpret common effect-size measures;
- calculate effect sizes and sampling variances;
- fit and interpret random-effects meta-analysis;
- distinguish uncertainty in the mean effect from heterogeneity among true effects;
- use prediction intervals appropriately;
- recognise and model dependent effect sizes;
- use meta-regression cautiously;
- conduct useful sensitivity analyses;
- recognise limitations of publication-bias diagnostics; and
- translate model results into appropriately qualified conclusions.

## Software

```r
install.packages(c("metafor", "tidyverse"))
```
